latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 of legacy-code-symptom-router – initial release.

- Provides a plain-language diagnostic to match legacy code problems with the right technique from “Working Effectively with Legacy Code.”
- Routes developer complaints (e.g., “can’t test this class,” “changes take forever”) to specific downstream skills and techniques.
- Covers 19 common legacy code symptoms; outputs a triage artifact and recommended next step.
- Designed to be the first point of contact for vague or specific legacy code struggles.
- Works with any programming language and does not require direct code access.
